netcongestie.intro: The power grid is full and that affects your hotel directly. Here we explain what grid congestion is, why it is a problem for the hospitality industry and how Lemnion solves it.
netcongestie.s1h: Traffic jam on the power grid
netcongestie.s1p: Grid congestion means that the electricity grid at a certain location can no longer handle additional capacity. It is comparable to a motorway in rush hour: nothing more can be added. Grid operators can no longer provide heavier connections, which means businesses sometimes have to wait years for an expansion.
netcongestie.f1p: Wants to expand, become more sustainable or install EV chargers. Requests more capacity from the grid operator.
netcongestie.f2p: The grid is full. No additional capacity available. Waiting time: 2 to 5 years.
netcongestie.f3p: Battery storage + EMS + solar panels = your own energy. Immediately available, without waiting for grid reinforcement.
netcongestie.summary: In short: grid congestion is a traffic jam on the power grid. Lemnion builds your own slip road so your hotel does not have to sit in the queue.
netcongestie.s2p: Hotels have a distinctive consumption pattern. Between 17:00 and 21:00 consumption shoots up: kitchens run at full speed, guests shower, air conditioners and lifts are used to the maximum. This is exactly the moment grid congestion strikes.
netcongestie.c1p: Store cheap night-time electricity in a 261 kWh LFP battery. Use this stored energy during expensive peak hours. This keeps you below your contracted capacity and avoids penalties.
netcongestie.c2p: The Energy Management System is the smart brain that automatically charges and discharges at the most favourable moments. Real-time insight and dynamic tariff control.
netcongestie.c3p: Generate your own energy and store the surplus in the battery. Up to 80% self-sufficient, so you only need the grid as a backup.
